requirements.requirement: The system must accept a complete set of valid weight parameters and recompute provider scores using those weights.
The system must accept a complete set of valid weight parameters and recompute clinical trial scores using those weights.
The system must normalize all provided weights such that their total equals 1.0 before applying scoring logic.
The system must produce identical scores to baseline logic when default weights are applied.
The system must recompute scores deterministically such that identical inputs (data + weights) always produce identical outputs.
The system must support partial weight inputs by filling missing measures with default weights before normalization.
The system must fallback entirely to default weights when provided weights fail validation.
The system must reject or correct negative weight values during preprocessing before scoring.
The system must handle zero-weight measures by excluding their contribution from the final score calculation.
The system must recompute scores within an acceptable response time threshold consistent with existing evaluation performance.
The system must include metadata in the scoring output indicating which weights were applied (user vs default).
The system must ensure score outputs remain within defined bounds (e.g., 0–100 or 0–1) after applying weights.
The system must handle invalid weight formats (e.g., non-numeric values) by triggering fallback to default weights without system failure.
The system must log weight inputs and scoring outcomes for traceability and debugging.
The system must ensure compatibility with existing evaluation pipelines without requiring changes to upstream data providers.
